name: civicAPI
summary: Live and historic election results and race calls for elections around the world, from local races to national ones.
notes: Keyless and free, including commercial use; non-personal projects must credit civicAPI (link to civicapi.org or name it).
All times are UTC; election_date in search results is set to 05:00 UTC whatever the local zone.

endpoints.name: Search races
endpoints.summary: Elections (races) by country, province, district, type, date range or name, with top-three candidates, votes, percent reporting and winners.

startDate.description: Races on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Races on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

query.description: Race name; slow, so prefer the other filters.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (US); alpha-3 for countries of limited recognition or abolished before the UN.

province.description: ISO 3166-2 province code, e.g. AL or JP-07.

district.description: District (county, canton) by full English name.

limit.description: Races to return; 20 by default, at most 50000.

endpoints.name: Get a race
endpoints.summary: Full results of one race: candidates, votes, percent, winners, registered voters, poll times and per-region results.

data.description: json (default), or csv for an OpenElections-compatible CSV.

notes: Precinct results are left out unless they are the only data; the docs' precinct flag adds them.

endpoints.name: List snapshots of a race
endpoints.summary: Timestamps of the stored snapshots of a race's results, for timelines.
notes: Only races tracked after 2025-10-09 have history.

endpoints.name: Get a race as at a snapshot
endpoints.summary: A race's full results as they stood at one snapshot timestamp.

endpoints.name: List election dates
endpoints.summary: Dates with elections in a year, by month, with race counts, optionally for one country or province.

year.description: Year, YYYY; the current year by default.

province.description: Province code, e.g. AL or JP-06.

endpoints.name: List election years
endpoints.summary: Every year with elections in the database.
